news.headline: Strait of Hormuz: UN agencies call for diplomacy to end attacks

news.headline: Afghanistan: 3.7 million young lives at risk of malnutrition, UNICEF warns
news.summary: Some 3.7 million children under five in Afghanistan are at heightened risk of malnutrition due to food insecurity, poor diets and inadequate access to basic services as the peak season for life-threatening wasting looms.&nbsp;
